email.subject: Pulse Fitness: quick fix for lost calls
email.body:
Hi Marcus,

I checked Pulse Fitness's website. Two things are likely costing you members in Harbor Falls:

1. There's no click-to-call link, so anyone browsing on their phone has to manually dial or copy your number. Most won't bother, especially when comparing gyms.
2. Your page title doesn't mention "Harbor Falls" or "gym/fitness," which hurts how you show up in local Google searches against competitors who do.

Both are quick, flat-fee fixes. Happy to walk you through exactly what I'd change in a free 10-minute call, no pitch, no pressure.

Worth 10 minutes this week?

Alex
